name: CQ | 200mg Live Resin Syrup | Blackberry Lemon Lime
description:
CBN SIESTA CONCORD GRAPE SYRUP

WITH LIVE RESIN (STRAIN: GRAPES OF WRATH)

NIGHTTIME 200mg THC, 40mg CBN

Makes 20 Drinks. 1 capful = 10mg THC, 2mg CBN.

Our calming combination of THC and CBN supports sleep, pain relief, and inflammation. An herbal blend of valerian, lemon balm, and glycine synergistically support rest and relaxation. Ingestible effects lasts longer than smoking to help you all night long. Made with real fruit and sweetened with cane sugar.

Sip straight or mix.

The dosing window on the side of the bottle allows you to accurately track your consumption. 2 oz travel-size bottle, childproof reclosable cap. VEGAN, NO GLUTEN, NON-GMO. CONSUMPTION ADVICE: Start with 1 capful (10mg THC, 2mg CBN) and wait 45 minutes before drinking more.

No refrigeration required.

Tastes best cold.

INGREDIENTS: Vegetable Glycerine, Cane Sugar, Glycine (1000mg), Water, Cannabis Live Resin Extract, Natural Flavors, Citric Acid, Valerian Root (300mg), Lemon Balm (300mg), Organic Fruit & Vegetable Juice (for color), Potassium Sorbate, Malic Acid, Terpenes, Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid).
